about: The message under the lead of the sign-in: the message of the language shown, else the English one, else none. Read by brand.test.ts (the page script, brandMessage) and by the Rust test the_page_script_and_the_server_choose_the_same_message (obop-commands, brand/tests/rows.rs, Brand::message). The same file holds the longest name, short name, title and message the policy of the record allows, in characters, and the largest artwork in bytes (`limits`), which the Identity tab counts against: read by identity.test.ts and by the Rust test the_longest_texts_of_the_form_are_those_of_the_policy (obop-commands, brand/tests/rows.rs). A case is the messages that are set, the language shown and the text it shows (empty: none).
